intent: Analyze ASUS TUF Gaming B650E Motherboard with Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU and RX 9060 XT GPU for potential issues.
detected_fault: Periodic freeze every 3 seconds, dip in GPU usage during freeze, and all performance metrics dipping together
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest stable version (if available)
Check for firmware updates for motherboard and GPU
Disable background tasks, cache flushing, and power-saving features
